title: HDEEG2ECG: ECG reconstruction from high-density EEG, with a reference-free quality-control toolbox
description: Model code, trained weights, the three-stage inference and quality-control toolbox, and the analysis code for Fraile-Vazquez et al., 'HDEEG2ECG: Electrocardiogram reconstruction from raw high-density electroencephalography data'. No recordings are included.

creators.name: Fraile-Vazquez, Matias E.
creators.affiliation: Life Span Institute, University of Kansas
